gen-gf-dm-mono-fs-literata: Crisp, code-minded letters: DM Mono marches along at fixed widths with zero stroke modulation, while Literata's classic serif swells gently. That machine-meets-bookish gap is the single thing that makes the pairing memorable.
gen-gf-dongle-fs-literata: A thread of rounded-wire ink, that's Dongle up top. Literata below is a serif with modest contrast, like lightly engraved brass, so it feels solid beside that wire.
gen-gf-doppio-one-fs-literata: Modern and plain, Doppio One keeps its strokes lean and low in contrast, while Literata's text serif adds a gentle thick-thin rhythm. Paragraphs in it flow smoothly, with open curves that carry the eye.
gen-gf-doto-fs-literata: Sparse and spaced-out: Doto lets its terminals stop short and keeps contrast low. And Literata, a text serif, supplies restrained thick-thin shading in every glyph, grounding that scattered looseness with a steadier hand.
gen-gf-dynapuff-mulish: DynaPuff's letters each sit alone with space around them, in a pen-like line of constant weight. It makes the statement, while Mulish, a sans-serif, does the quiet, open-mouthed reading.
gen-gf-dynapuff-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab holds the line with a dense middle zone and open throats, a slab-serif of firm structure. But DynaPuff's marker-nib line stays up top while paragraphs below read firm and orderly.
gen-gf-el-messiri-fs-literata: El Messiri brings middling stroke contrast and curves that stop short instead of closing in. And Literata's serif text moves along steadily, its open-mouthed curves easy company for the eye.
gen-gf-encode-sans-expanded-fs-literata: A funnel-wide throat in the e marks Encode Sans Expanded, low in contrast and plainly modern. Literata, a classic serif with a soft contrast, sits beside it looking warmer and more bookish.
gen-gf-encode-sans-sc-fs-literata: Encode Sans SC never turns the ends of its c inward, and its strokes stay low in contrast. And Encode earns its keep big and short, while Literata, a text serif, grades its weight smoothly.
gen-gf-encode-sans-semi-condensed-fs-lit: Literata arrives as a classic serif with visible, subtle modulation. Encode Sans Semi Condensed does best with a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut, Literata with warm, sustained text.
